endorsements.name: Christina Kubecka
endorsements.label: How to Implement IT Security After a Cyber Meltdown
endorsements.description: The 2012 cyber attacks against Saudi Aramco and the Aramco family of affiliates was a major game changer in IT & ICS Security. The energy sector, relevant markets, and governments world wide shuddered. Although oil production wasn't directly affected, business operations were greatly interrupted and remain so. This presentation is the story how I implemented the first IT Security unit for Aramco Overseas Company, a Saudi Aramco affiliate which provides all IT services for Saudi Aramco in South America and the EMEA region outside of Saudi Arabia.
